role.title: Software Engineer
role.context: Fintech company, payment processing and financial services

cards.title: Card scheme and payment integrations
cards.summary: Integrated the platform with card schemes and payment methods: Mastercard and Visa over ISO 8583, EMV 3-D Secure for Visa and Mastercard, and BLIK.

cards.title: Monitoring and settlement
cards.summary: Ran and developed an internal monitoring and settlement system, and supported financial analysts with the data and tooling they needed.

cards.title: Regulatory integrations
cards.summary: Built integrations with national and European regulatory systems, working with sensitive data and taking part in compliance audits.

cards.title: Client-facing APIs
cards.summary: Planned the API offered to clients and supported them through integration with the system, from documentation to troubleshooting.

cards.title: Production ownership
cards.summary: Third-line support and on-call, resolving critical production issues, planning and executing deployments, writing tests and documentation, and sharing good practices with other developers.
